text:
chris_sales: Hey team — Acme is ready to kick off a 2-week POC. They want a Dedicated GPU pool. Requesting guidance + provisioning.

chris_sales: Summary: 4 GPUs, prefer A100-80GB, region us-west2, start window Apr 12, expected concurrency ~8, avg seq ~1024, peak 2048. Need API keys scoped to their service account, and a short SSO/KMS checklist for security. Any blockers?

mike_se: @chris_sales thanks — quick Qs: is this for chat-only or embeddings/rerank too? Also what's the expected token throughput (tokens/sec) at peak?

chris_sales: chat + embeddings. Rough estimate: 8 concurrent sessions with ~15 toks/sec each -> ~120 toks/sec sustained, bursts up to ~300 toks/sec.

axel_infra: Got it. A100-80GB in us-west2 is available but H100 offers lower latency for batch; A100 still fine for token-based chat. For 8 concurrency with 2048 sequence, 4x A100-80GB looks reasonable for POC. We'll need a capacity request + infra approval (network/VPC peering). Link to runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/dedicated-provisioning

axel_infra: Also need the customer SRE contact and the desired network model: peered VPC or managed private endpoint? Peered VPC will need a ticket to network ops (2–3 business days).

chris_sales: They prefer peered VPC. SRE: sre@acme.example.com. Can we get the pool ready by Apr 12 if we submit today?

axel_infra: If approvals are fast, yes. I'll raise the provisioning request now. Expect ~48–72 hours to spin up after approvals.

anita_ps: @chris_sales looping in Security. For the questionnaire: confirm whether customer data will remain in the private pool (yes/no) and whether they require BYOK keys. Also confirm any HIPAA/GDPR controls needed.

chris_sales: Data stays in the private pool (no cross-tenant sharing). They want KMS-managed keys (BYOK optional). No HIPAA but GDPR compliance required.

anita_ps: OK. We'll prep the security answers and a short attestation. ETA 1 business day.

infra-bot: Pool request created: PRJ-ACME-487 | 4x A100-80GB | us-west2 | owner: axel_infra | status: requested

axel_infra: Created the internal request. Next steps: network ticket, billing approval for POC (hourly or short-term reserved), and service account + scoped API key.

chris_sales: Pricing question from Acme: do we bill POC hourly or offer a POC rate (discount)? What's standard?

mike_se: For POCs we usually do hourly metered billing on Dedicated with a temporary promo credit. For enterprise conversions we move to monthly reserved commits. I'll DM finance for a quick POC quote (will include expected token costs + GPU hourly).

chris_sales: Perfect. Also need the exact pool SKU to give to the customer in the SOW. Please confirm sku string I should include.

axel_infra: Use sku: "redwood.dedicated.a100_80gb.v1" — include region and qty. Example: redwood.dedicated.a100_80gb.v1 | us-west2 | qty:4

chris_sales: Noted. Any extra config snippets I can paste into the SOW for network/keys?

axel_infra: Paste this minimal config snippet into SOW (customers like to see it):

```json
{
  "pool_sku": "redwood.dedicated.a100_80gb.v1",
  "region": "us-west2",
  "quantity": 4,
  "network": "vpc-peering",
  "kms": "customer-managed-BYOK (optional)"
}
```
chris_sales: Awesome — thank you.

anita_ps: Security will provide the questionnaire answers and a short network diagram. I'll attach the SOC2/ISO artifacts if needed.

axel_infra: I'll update the provisioning ticket with the peering steps and the expected provision ETA. Will post the ticket link here when ready.

infra-bot: Provisioning ticket updated: TKT-9321 (network ops). ETA after approvals: 72 hours.

chris_sales: Great — please ping once pool is up and send the scoped API key + instructions for the SRE to test. :thumbsup:

mike_se: Quick note for the team: if performance regresses during the POC we can flip to an H100 variant mid-POC and bill the delta. Keep performance traces and token-level latency dashboards enabled.

chris_sales: Copy that. Thanks everyone.

axel_infra: I'll follow up with the ticket link and provisioning progress in this thread.

chris_sales: Closing loop — will update Acme with SKU + rough pricing once finance replies.
